scope: Independent source and focused host-only test review. No implementation duplication, source/freeze edits, old receipt regeneration, firmware/source acquisition, real ring allocation/DMA, hardware/SSH/boot or Signal.

opaque_fixture.meaning: Exact synthetic pattern only; no type/opcode/flags/request ID/endian field/firmware validity is assigned. Header and README explicitly prohibit sending it to physical firmware.
opaque_fixture.reference_fallback_verified: The local pinned brcmfmac directory contains only chip.c, firmware.c and pcie.c; no msgbuf source/header. This slice neither fetches a missing ABI nor substitutes an invented one.

length_and_preserved_output.encode: Requires bytes==8 and nonnull output, then readiness and checked pointer overlap rejection against active ring buffer/ring object/parent; memcpy writes exactly8 only after every check. All prior failure paths preserve output.
length_and_preserved_output.check: Requires exactly8/non-null before reads, then readiness and all8-byte memcmp; no mutation. Read-only check of a retained ring slot is permitted.
length_and_preserved_output.bounds: No subtraction/length multiplication from caller size; short, oversized and SIZE_MAX rejected before memory access or I/O. Caller still owns valid accessible pointers; this C API is not arbitrary-pointer containment.

order.submit: bfi_check must return0 before calling unchanged bcr_submit; malformed bytes cannot reach buffer/index/doorbell mutations.
order.inherited_ring: Preserves existing leave-one-empty FULL policy, buffer->producer publication/readback->endpoint bell order, wrap, sticky partial-mutation failure and retained backing. No new low-level write routine, allocation or retry.

readiness.entry: Bound/configured/not closed ring; BCT_SHARED and un-faulted parent; exact8-byte ring item size; genuine checked fake accessor identity. PHY mask0x8f==0x0f, RUNbit0, LINKmask0x45==1, PCI14e4:4425, final PHY sample.
readiness.initial_failure: Before ring admission a guard read error/readiness refusal returns the error and preserves ring/output, without pretending a successful submission or latching an unrelated ring mutation.
readiness.after_admission: Old ring per-access guards and dirty/inflight/fault retention remain operative. Initial/final PHY samples are instantaneous, not protection against arbitrary later hardware failure.

gates.default_and_host_KERNEL: All3 APIs compile to unconditional BFI_GATED with no state or output access, I/O, compare/copy, bcr_submit or allocation.
gates.negative_compiles: BFI_FAKE_DEVICE+KERNEL, APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE, missing BCR_FAKE_DEVICE and missing APB_HOST_TEST_ACCESSOR are refused.
gates.profile: Normal working fixture compiles BFI_FAKE_DEVICE/BCR_FAKE_DEVICE/BCT_FAKE_BAR_FILE/APB_HOST_TEST_ACCESSOR together. The item translation unit directly enforces BFI/BCR/accessor; BCT fake enablement is inherited from the public parent setup, not a separate item-level preprocessor check.
gates.forbidden_operations_absent: No write32, shared PHY/PMGR write, GPIO152/SMC drive, T8103 MSI layout, firmware command/download, real DMA or physical mapping in this item codec.

reviewed_contract.lifetime: Caller retains stable disjoint owners/buffers and serializes operations; no threads, background callbacks, ownership transfer, freeing, rollback or drain claim introduced.
